manualAssessment.method: 15 traces fixed before rebuilding; single human/model assistant reading of actual query, stimulus and selected evidence; subjective, not blind or population precision

definitions.relevant: helps current topic or historical continuity
definitions.irrelevant: incidental shared person/place is insufficient to explain current stimulus
definitions.redundant: same meaning already delivered, including full context repetitions; different source records can still be redundant
